svg.title: iOS · Shape-mation · builder · match · circle · portrait
svg.desc: Design-first, 2026-09-11 (Steven: 'a followup input to decide how strict this should be for each with aspect ratio inputs as well'). The Match step is NEW: pushed from the family row of ShapemationBuilderView (back reads 'Shape slideshow'), before the projects step, large title 'Match'. It narrows the family to the shapes the slideshow can land on one another: every control is label-above and full-width inside one white llCard (radius 18, 16-pt padding) in the grammar of the Adjust screen's time-slicing card — LLInkSegment-style segmented controls (E9E9EB track, white knob) and capsule chips (accent when chosen). Under the card a 12-pt secondary readout counts what passes ('N projects · M <shapes> match'), live as the controls change, and the bottom safeAreaInset bar carries 'Next · projects' (disabled when nothing matches). The match is saved with the Shape-mation record so a re-render reproduces it; family membership itself is unchanged, Match only narrows. Same geometry as the other builder steps (sheet top 69, question at 209, card at 225). CIRCLE: one control, Roundness — Strict (minor ÷ major ≥ 0.95) · Normal (≥ 0.85, the family's own threshold today) · Loose (≥ 0.70). Loose is the café case: a mug's rim seen from the side is an oval of a round thing, and the renderer un-tilts it — stretches the minor axis to the major — so every rim lands as a circle. Nothing new is stored for ellipses: minor/major and the major axis' angle are already in the register. Drawn at Normal with the 2026-09-11 library's counts.

g.text: Rims at least 85 % round. Strict is 95 %. Loose takes rims
seen from the side, down to 70 %, and levels each into a
circle — mugs shot from above and from the side agree.
